text: Equipment noise shall not exceed 85 dB(A) at 1 m from any equipment in normal operation (ER-14.03) and the plant noise shall not exceed 45 dB(A) LAeq at night (and the day limit DP-EPCE-0010 of the EIA) at the nearest sensitive receptor (ER-14.04); the requirement shall be verified by the noise study (HS-STU-0001), which shall use the sound power levels guaranteed by the suppliers, and by the noise survey after commissioning (ER-16.05).
